documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.text: Our regional logistics team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's regional logistics team is exploring options but has not identified a specific requirement or project owner. This lack of clarity is creating operational friction, as the team is unable to proceed with a discovery meeting without further clarification.

To ensure we address the right needs, could you clarify what specific challenges or goals you're looking to solve with Cedar Systems? This will help us prepare for a discovery meeting that aligns with your priorities.
